grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and residency status before booking your test

grants.description: Check your provisional driving licence and theory test records with DVLA and DVSA
grants.purpose: To verify you have a valid provisional licence and have passed your theory test

grants.description: Provide payment information to pay for your test
grants.purpose: To pay the test fee (£62 weekday or £75 evening/weekend/bank holiday)

grants.description: Check your driving instructor's availability at your chosen test time
grants.purpose: To confirm your instructor is available for your test appointment
To schedule and confirm your driving test appointment

revocation.mechanism: Cancel your test through the DVSA booking system or by calling 0300 200 1122
revocation.effect: Your test booking will be cancelled. Refunds available if cancelled at least 3 working days before your test.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payment on your behalf without explicit confirmation. Agent cannot cancel a confirmed booking. Agent cannot attend the test on your behalf.
